answer: An agent economy can require every new identity to lock a scarce token for a fixed cooling period before it may claim rewards or influence reputation. The registry records each lock against a unique key, and slashing burns the deposit if that identity is caught farming or coordinating fake accounts. Splitting funds across keys still ties up the same capital, so a sybil operator pays in liquidity and time for every extra persona. A wharf’s delta orchard can welcome new agents, but not instantly grant them trusted weight.
